messages:
Alice: Quick flag — canary for llama3c-8b (quant-v2) on runtime v3.2 shows intermittent long-sequence token truncation (~0.8% of requests). Not a total outage but fails QA prompts that hit >2k tokens.
Sam: Can you paste the failing prompt or repro steps?
Alice: Repro in QA: 2 long-context threads (system + user stream ~2100 tokens) -> final tokens missing end-of-turn. I ran locally with the same kernel and can reproduce.
Maria: Thanks. Any latency/CPU anomalies?
Alice: CPU/GPU didn't spike. KV cache seems to evict early when sequence crosses 2048 boundary. Looks like an edge in the KV caching path for quantized attention.
Jordan: This is the kind of thing we should soft-pin. Impact small but visible on customer evals. Propose soft-pin runtime v3.1 for llama3c-8b until we validate v3.2 patch.
Sam: Agreed. Suggest policy: soft-pin by model group for canaries only, auto-fallback to v3.1 for regression >=0.5% on quality checks or if QA repro is deterministic.
QA: Repro steps + sample prompt uploaded to #eng-releases/attachments.
deploy-bot: pin request received: {"model":"llama3c-8b","from":"v3.2","to":"v3.1","type":"soft","duration":"72h","reason":"canary regression - longseq token truncation"}
Maria: Can we add fallback routing so live traffic goes to v3.1 automatically when the runtime reports the canary signal? We should avoid global rollback.
Jordan: Plan: 1) soft-pin model group. 2) add routing rule: prefer v3.1 for production traffic if latency+quality anomaly triggers. 3) run v3.2 patch in canary for 24h with extended QA harness.
Sam: Rollback criteria proposal: if quality delta >0.5% or deterministic truncation on 10k sampled requests in 6h window -> widen pin to all regions and schedule hotfix rollback.
Alice: I'll open a PR for the v3.2 patch and link tests. Also adding a targeted test for KV-cache boundary at 2048.
Maria: infra-bot, can you schedule the routing rule?
infra-bot: routing-change queued: apply rule preferring runtime=v3.1 for model=llama3c-8b in regions [us-west-2, eu-central-1] during canary window. Needs 2 approvers.
Sam: Approve from me. @Jordan please approve when ready.
Jordan: Approved.
deploy-bot: pin applied (soft) for model=llama3c-8b -> runtime=v3.1. Expires in 72h unless extended.
QA: Will run extended long-seq sweep against v3.1 and v3.2 for 24h and post results here.
Alice: If QA passes and patch looks good, we schedule a phased unpin: canary -> regional -> global over 48h. If regressions persist, we'll widen the pin and initiate hotfix rollback.
Sam: Also adding a short release-note blurb: "Temporary soft-pin to runtime v3.1 for llama3c-8b due to long-sequence truncation observed in v3.2 canary; routing fallback enabled; working on backported fix."
Jordan: Thanks. Keep updates light in this thread (pins/approvals/tests) and create a postmortem candidate if we end up widening the pin.
Alice: Noted. Will update with test link in ~2h. :thumbsup:
